timing_caveats: Buckets are nested and cumulative; do not add journal, native, snapshot, apply/remove and startup totals.
First latch is owner-wide and may be an earlier WPA cancellation, not the current apply attempt.
Owner SIGKILL can prevent timing finally blocks: a call with zero recorded duration/failures is censored, not a successful zero-time operation.
Fixed50ms on tmpfs does not reproduce real-disk fsync tail latency; measured maxima are not worst-case bounds.
limits: Only the exact guarded K6 IPv4/IPv6 fixture has pressure50 proof; maximum accepted profile cardinality and replacement renewals can exceed these deadlines.
WPA and physical radio are fixture substitutes. Physical rfkill, real association and hardware block latency are not validated.
Parent host checks compare snapshots; they are not continuous observation of all transient state. Native02 remains a failed DHCP-list comparison.
Captured native writer was alive at owner kill, but completion was proved before replacement startup. A surviving-writer/new-observer native teardown proof remains separate.
Resolver repair requires the intact managed signature and validated libc-only provider policy; missing/truncated signature remains refusal.
Controller remains staged; live migration, deployed behavior and OpenRC activation/readiness remain separate.
A quiet native07 success does not erase native06 low-level deadline refusal or establish robustness under arbitrary host load.
